info.name: Course catalog, batches and public pricing regression
info.description: Run only with the disposable PostgreSQL/Auth emulator harness. Money is integer BDT. Course publication is outside this API.

exec: pm.test("Only published offerings", () => { pm.expect(body.data.total).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.data.items[0].title).to.equal('Published Web Design'); pm.expect(body.data.items[0].batches).to.have.length(2); });

item.name: Public details hide private data and enforce money totals

exec: pm.test("Valid combinations and safe fields", () => { const b=body.data.batches.find(b=>b.id===pm.environment.get('publicBatchId')); pm.expect(b.seatsAvailable).to.equal(17); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('onlineLocation'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('leadMentorId'); pm.expect(b.mentor).to.deep.equal({id:pm.environment.get("mentorId"),name:"mentor fixture"}); pm.expect(b.plans.find(p=>p.count===3).amounts).to.deep.equal([4001,4000,4000]); b.plans.forEach(p=>pm.expect(p.amounts.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)).to.equal(p.total)); pm.expect(b.classes[0].startsAt).to.equal('2027-01-04T12:00:00.000Z'); pm.expect(b.classes[1].startsAt).to.equal('2027-01-07T12:00:00.000Z'); pm.expect(new Set(b.classes.map(c=>c.id)).size).to.equal(6); pm.expect(body.data.batches.find(b=>b.id===pm.environment.get('fullBatchId')).seatsAvailable).to.equal(0); });
